title: preview preflight job payload

collectionId.description: The collection the source would be in.

settings.description: The unsaved Sources.Settings, valid against contracts/sources/v1/{sourceType}.schema.json (the admin checks it, V25); a URL list sends its first 20 URLs only.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of a preview job of kind preflight (connectors design §2.2; admin design §4.7, §5.4 step 4): reachability, robots, sitemaps, estimated pages against maxPages, egress and CMS of an unsaved URL-list or crawl configuration. No dedup.
